exact_statement: Extend A056 v5 in its private-point-activation fair-mux model of arbitrary shared Boolean phases with supplied empty-calibrated support-dominating references. Give source j one original reset allowance Lj*wj,root*I(j_root). At a finite adaptive frontier, at most once per source on any path, permit a pure fresh reference Sj with the same empty atom and Sj(T)>=2^(-Lj)Rj,current(T) for all nonempty T. Then the exact signed root reset excess is wj(1-aj)[CE(Pj,Sj)-CE(Pj,Rj,current)], its positive part is at most Lj*wj*I(j), and total expected positive bookings are at most the original allowances. All actual physical CE releases, prior debits and complete terminal H+KL costs fit inside the SAME original root bound K I(root), K=max(Cu+1+Lu,Cv+1+Lv,7), if original source costs satisfy cj<=Cj I(j). No allowance is renewed. Concrete corollary: arbitrary original3-bit phases with equal-nonempty references have c<=3I by an exact256-function certificate. After at least one shared query, each source may once be reset to the prescribed pure fresh law S(0)=mean^2, S(T)=Var*2^(T-1)/(2^(2^d-1)-1) for d<=2 remaining phase bits (point mass for d0). It obeys7S>=R and is paid by L=3 from original unused3Icore at the SAME rate7 for all private point widths and permitted finite adaptive frontiers. After both resets, endpoint3I certificates and subsequent physical transport also give individual-terminal7I. Exact264 mixed fixtures/1056 reset states and subsequent shared queries verify the complete ledger, including165 histories with positive per-source bookings. The dimension condition cannot be deleted for that geometric floor: padded u=v=x1*x2 with exact source references, a shared x2 query and private B query has Iroot=7/4 and four nonconstant prefix states, but fresh u-reset price=(1/8)log2(2^(2^d-1)-1), exceeding7Iroot for everyd>=7. This is a reference-reset obstruction, not an FEI counterexample. Full FEI remains OPEN.
